note: Scripted debugging sequence. No model chooses these steps; they are fixed in advance.

steps.say: Run the test suite to see what fails.
The tier test fails at exactly the minimum quantity; check the comparison.
A tier applies from its minimum: change > to >=.
steps.command: sed -i 's/if quantity > minimum:/if quantity >= minimum:/' /app/stockroom/pricing.py && grep -n 'minimum:' /app/stockroom/pricing.py
